hints.title: Polynomial Term Multiplication
hints.text: Multiplying a term of degree i with a term of degree j contributes to the degree i + j in the product.

hints.title: Result Array Sizing
hints.text: The maximum degree of the resulting polynomial is degree(poly1) + degree(poly2), giving length n1 + n2 - 1.

hints.title: Discrete Convolution
hints.text: Iterate through all pairs (i, j) adding poly1[i] * poly2[j] into result[i + j].

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Algebraic expansion of polynomials cannot skip degree pairs without FFT.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct accumulation in the output array requires zero extra memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Explain discrete convolution and degree dimension boundaries.
